snippet.title: A New Legend Begins Today — Shard Legends: INTRO (Official Trailer)
snippet.description:
Not every story begins at the beginning.
Some worlds break into pieces. Some legends fade.
And some… are rebuilt by those brave enough to gather the fragments.

Shard Legends: INTRO is the epic 90-day prologue to a massive cross-platform MMORPG universe.
You don’t enter a finished world — you create it.

Build the first cities.
Lead expeditions into the unknown.
Earn eternal Titles.
Shape the future Clan Wars era long before the first blade is drawn.

This trailer reveals the forgotten truth behind the Empire — a story pieced together from ruins, memories, and the choices of the first explorers.

🔥 Play now on Telegram & Web.
Your name will be written in the Chronicles.
Your decisions will define the world.
Your legend begins… right now.

⭐ Key Features:

• 90-day world-building cycle
• Player-driven lore and history
• Expeditions, exploration & crafting
• City ownership system
• NFT Title forging (optional)
• Zero-friction onboarding

🔗 Play Shard Legends
